newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy Freedom Alliance has 1,000 budget amendments.
newsitem.headline: Italy Freedom Alliance has 1,000 budget amendments.

text.p: Italy's centre-right Freedom Alliance said on Friday it had presented 1,000 amendments to the 1997 budget and promised "intransigent opposition" to the government's austerity economic measures.

Antonio Marzano, an economist belonging to Freedom Alliance leader Silvio Berlusconi's Forza Italia party, told a news conference the bloc would present 1,000 amendments, not 700 as had previously been announced.

The separatist Northern League party said earlier that it would present 1,800 amendments and the ruling centre-right coalition has already said it will present a limited number of amendments of its own.
The budget commission has until October 28 to examine all the proposed amendments and will then pass the draft law to the full lower Chamber of Deputies for debate.
The lower house of parliament has until November 17 to approve the budget after which it goes to the upper house (Senate) for discussion. The budget must by law be approved by the end of the year.
